___________ Original Message ___________________
From : support15@demo.co.uk
To : reservations@autouni
Date 2025-07-05 13:45
____________________________________________

 
 I hope this message finds you well. 
  
 We are planning to rent an Audi Q3 (or similar) from your Athens location from Sunday, August 3 to Thursday, August 14, 2025 — a total of 11 days. I would like to confirm a few details before finalizing the booking.
 
 We would like to register three drivers for the rental: 
  
  
 Myself 
  
  
 My wife (age 50) 
  
  
 Our daughter Kyra (age 21), license holder for 2 years 10 months 
  
  
 Could you kindly confirm: 
  
  
 Whether all three of us are eligible to be registered as drivers under this booking 
  
  
 If there are any additional fees or documentation required for the third driver 
  
  
 Whether cross-border travel to North Macedonia is permitted for this vehicle/class, and if so, what the insurance and documentation requirements are 
  
  
 We’re looking forward to a scenic and comfortable trip across northern Greece and possibly into North Macedonia, and want to ensure everything is in order well ahead of time. 
  
 Thank you in advance for your help — we greatly appreciate your assistance. 
  
 Warm regards, 
  
 Mazda Casey Johnson
